title: AP-MT061-AcpClientCore

scope.summary:
GOAL: Integrate the official agent-client-protocol Rust crate (crates.io: agent-client-protocol, companion agent-client-protocol-schema) as a Handshake session adapter so any ACP-speaking agent (claude-agent-acp, Gemini CLI native ACP, Codex via the Zed adapter) becomes a drivable Handshake agent session: supervised child-process spawn, initialize capability negotiation, session/new, session/prompt, streamed session/update notifications translated into the Handshake TurnItem stream, and complete stop-reason mapping to turn terminal states. ACP (Agent Client Protocol, agentclientprotocol.com, JetBrains co-develops with Zed) is JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio and reuses MCP JSON types; Handshake already carries JSON-RPC infrastructure under src/backend/handshake_core/src/mcp/ (jsonrpc.rs, transport/) whose framing/backpressure patterns are the reference, while the ACP wire implementation itself MUST come from the official crate, never hand-rolled.

EXPECTED DIFF SHAPE: New submodule src/backend/handshake_core/src/agent_sessions/acp/ containing mod.rs (public adapter surface + AcpAdapterError), client_core.rs (spawn + connection + session lifecycle), capability_map.rs (ACP agent capabilities -> MT-003 AdapterCapabilities), turn_stream.rs (session/update -> TurnItem translation + stop-reason mapping). One dependency line added to src/backend/handshake_core/Cargo.toml (agent-client-protocol, pinned semver range). Integration test file(s) under src/backend/handshake_core/tests/ plus an in-repo conforming fake-agent test fixture binary built on the SAME crate's agent side, so tests exercise real ACP protocol bytes over real stdio, not mocked Handshake internals.

DETAILED SPEC:
- SPAWN (supervised): the ACP agent child process is spawned through the MT-005 session supervisor, never via a bare Command::spawn. Process attribution mirrors the hardened pattern in src/backend/handshake_core/src/model_runtime/cloud/official_cli_bridge.rs: a call-boundary invocation identity (owner_role, model_identity, session attribution — see CliInvocation, line ~157) and ProcessOwnershipLedger registration that fails closed (mirror LedgerPreflight / LedgerRegistration error semantics: if the ledger cannot register the pid, the child is killed, never left unattributed). Child stdio runs over the MT-004 bidirectional stdio infrastructure. Windows: spawn with hidden window (no console flash), consistent with HBR-QUIET-001.
- INITIALIZE: perform the ACP initialize handshake (protocol version + client capabilities + agent capabilities). Map the agent's advertised capabilities into the MT-003 AdapterCapabilities surface with these hard rules: SteerMidTurn=false ALWAYS (ACP turns are strictly sequential; the protocol has NO mid-turn steer primitive — only cancel-then-reprompt, which MT-062 owns), Resume=true ONLY when the agent advertises the session-load capability (loadSession); never assume resume.
- SESSION LIFECYCLE: session/new with cwd bound to the assigned session worktree directory (MT-001 session model owns worktree binding); session/load only when the negotiated capability allows (full resume discipline and Windows regression coverage are MT-066; this MT wires the call path and the capability gate). The ACP SessionId is recorded on the MT-001 session record as the external thread identity.
- PROMPT TURN: session/prompt starts a turn; while the turn runs, consume streamed session/update notifications and translate each to a typed TurnItem published on the MT-009 session event bus. Minimum update kinds handled: agent_message_chunk, agent_thought_chunk, tool_call, tool_call_update, plan, usage_update. Unknown/unrecognized update kinds MUST be tolerated and preserved as a typed UnknownUpdate TurnItem carrying the raw JSON — never dropped silently, never a panic (adapters add kinds across versions).
- STOP-REASON MAPPING (exhaustive, no catch-all silently swallowing): end_turn -> TurnCompleted; max_tokens -> TurnTruncated(MaxTokens); max_turn_requests -> TurnTruncated(MaxTurnRequests); refusal -> TurnRefused; cancelled -> TurnCancelled. An unexpected/unknown stop reason maps to a typed TurnEndedUnknown carrying the raw value. The turn terminal state is written to the MT-001 session model and emitted as typed EventLedger events; FR event kinds per MT-161 when that MT has landed, else record the FR emit as DEFERRED-with-reason in the HBR-INT-009 evidence (never silently skipped).
- ERROR DISCIPLINE: agent process death mid-turn, malformed JSON-RPC, and initialize failure each settle the turn/session into a typed failure state with the child reaped by the MT-005 supervisor; no orphan processes, no hung futures.

STEP-BY-STEP IMPLEMENTATION:
1. Read the MT-001 session model, MT-003 capabilities surface, MT-004 stdio infra, and MT-005 supervisor contracts/code first; this adapter plugs into those seams and must not fork them.
2. Add agent-client-protocol to src/backend/handshake_core/Cargo.toml with a pinned compatible version range; build to verify the dependency tree (tokio/LocalSet or executor requirements of the crate must be reconciled with handshake_core's async runtime — inspect the crate docs/examples before wiring).
3. Create acp/mod.rs with AcpAdapterError (typed variants: SpawnFailed, LedgerPreflight, LedgerRegistration, InitializeFailed, CapabilityUnsupported, ProtocolError, AgentExited, TurnFailed) and the public AcpClientAdapter type.
4. Implement client_core.rs: supervised spawn (MT-005) + ProcessOwnershipLedger fail-closed registration + crate Client connection over the child stdio (MT-004).
5. Implement capability_map.rs: initialize negotiation -> AdapterCapabilities { steer_mid_turn: false, resume: <loadSession capability>, ... } per MT-003 shape.
6. Implement session/new (cwd = session worktree) and capability-gated session/load; persist the ACP SessionId on the session record.
7. Implement turn_stream.rs: session/prompt dispatch + session/update -> TurnItem translation + UnknownUpdate tolerance + stop-reason mapping table + terminal-state settlement on the session model + MT-009 event-bus publication + typed EventLedger emits.
8. Build the in-repo fake ACP agent fixture (a small bin target using the crate's agent side) that scripts: capability advertisement, a prompt turn streaming several update kinds including one unknown kind, and each of the five stop reasons on demand.
9. Author the integration tests listed under expected_tests against the fixture agent over real stdio.
10. Record HBR-INT-009 three-tier wiring outcomes (FR / internal_diagnostics / Palmistry) as build evidence, using WIRED or DEFERRED-with-reason per tier.
forbidden_paths: .GOV/** (the bridge is READ-ONLY reference for parity; never edited by this WP)
src/frontend/** (no GUI surface in this MT)
src/backend/handshake_core/src/mcp/** (reference-only reuse of JSON-RPC patterns; do not edit)
acceptance_criteria: agent-client-protocol crate is a declared dependency of handshake_core with a pinned version range; the ACP wire layer is NOT hand-rolled.

AcpClientAdapter spawns the agent child through the MT-005 supervisor with ProcessOwnershipLedger fail-closed attribution (unregisterable pid => child killed, typed error), mirroring official_cli_bridge.rs LedgerPreflight/LedgerRegistration semantics.

initialize negotiation populates MT-003 AdapterCapabilities with steer_mid_turn=false unconditionally and resume gated on the agent's loadSession capability; a fixture agent without loadSession yields resume=false.
session/new binds cwd to the session worktree and the returned ACP SessionId is persisted on the MT-001 session record.
A full prompt turn against the in-repo fixture agent streams TurnItems onto the MT-009 event bus for agent_message_chunk, tool_call, plan, and usage_update, in order.
An update of an unknown kind is preserved as a typed UnknownUpdate TurnItem (raw JSON retained) — proven by a test; no panic, no silent drop.

All five ACP stop reasons (end_turn, max_tokens, max_turn_requests, refusal, cancelled) map to their declared turn terminal states — proven by a parameterized test; an unknown stop reason maps to TurnEndedUnknown.
Agent process death mid-turn settles the turn into a typed failure state and the supervisor reaps the child (no orphan pid) — proven by a kill-the-fixture test.

Every session lifecycle transition (spawn, initialize, session-new, turn-start, turn-terminal, session-end) emits a typed EventLedger event; the run is reconstructable from durable state (HBR-INT-007).
HBR-INT-009 three-tier diagnostic outcomes recorded as build evidence: WIRED or DEFERRED-with-reason per tier; never silently skipped.
cargo build -p handshake_core green; new tests pass; no test opens a visible window or steals focus (HBR-QUIET-001).
expected_tests: acp_stop_reason_mapping (parameterized over all five reasons + unknown)
implementation_notes: MODULE-ROOT NOTE: the session-core family (MT-001/MT-004/MT-005, authored separately) owns the parent module. If that family lands the session layer under a different module root than agent_sessions/, place the acp/ submodule under THAT root and record the path deviation in this MT's lifecycle; the acp/ internal file layout in this contract remains binding.

Reuse pattern, not code: official_cli_bridge.rs (CliKind line ~63, CliInvocation line ~157, locked_file_identity line ~1084, GuardedCliChild line ~1829) shows the hardened spawn/attribution/identity discipline this adapter must match. Executable identity PINNING for real agent binaries is MT-064 (registry); this MT takes a resolved executable path + identity as input.

The fixture agent must speak real ACP via the same crate's agent side (real protocol bytes over real stdio). Mocking Handshake-internal traits instead of running the protocol is a Spec-Realism violation.

ACP reuses MCP JSON types; src/backend/handshake_core/src/mcp/jsonrpc.rs and mcp/transport/ are the in-repo reference for framing/backpressure/error-surface conventions — read them, do not edit them, do not duplicate their responsibilities.

Live third-party agents (claude-agent-acp, gemini, codex adapter) are OUT of this MT: MT-064 registers them, MT-066 contract-tests them. This MT's runtime proof is the in-repo conforming fixture agent.
usage_update: claude-agent-acp is KNOWN to not emit usage/cost events (July 2026). The TurnItem type must still exist and be exercised by the fixture agent; the live-agent gap is ledgered in MT-066.
All new UUID mint sites use Uuid::now_v7() per HBR-INT-008.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless backend MT: ACP client adapter has no operator-visible GUI surface; observable behavior is proven via typed EventLedger events and TraceProjection reconstruction per HBR-VIS-004.

target_entries: Agent sessions: ACP lane — what it is, which agents it can drive, sequential-turn limitation (no mid-turn steer), stop-reason meanings

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations: FLIGHT_RECORDER: ACP session lifecycle transitions (spawn, initialize, session-new, turn-start, turn-terminal, session-end) are business events — emit FR events using the MT-161 kinds when landed, else record DEFERRED-with-reason pointing at MT-161.

INTERNAL_DIAGNOSTICS: register the ACP adapter with the open diagnostic-event API (turn-in-flight state, child pid, last update kind, stall detection on a silent turn) — WIRED or DEFERRED-with-reason if internal_diagnostics is not yet shipped in this worktree.

PALMISTRY: an ACP agent child that freezes mid-turn is worth surviving-capture — register a liveness tracker for the supervised child, or record DEFERRED-with-reason if the external watcher is not yet available in this worktree.
risk_if_missed: No ACP client core exists: MT-062..066 are all blocked, the ACP pillar of WP-017 cannot start, and the repo-gov ACP-duty takeover (replacement of .GOV/tools/handshake-acp-bridge) has no product path.

risks: RISK-1: Hand-rolled ACP wire layer — reimplementing the JSON-RPC/ACP schema instead of using the official crate silently drifts from the spec as ACP evolves and duplicates mcp/ infrastructure.
RISK-2: Mock-based proof — tests that stub Handshake traits instead of speaking real ACP bytes over real stdio prove nothing about protocol conformance (Spec-Realism Gate).
RISK-3: Unattributed child processes — a spawn path that bypasses the MT-005 supervisor or tolerates ProcessOwnershipLedger failure leaves unkillable, unattributable agent processes.
RISK-4: Capability over-claim — advertising resume for an agent without loadSession, or any steer_mid_turn=true path, makes callers (MT-062, orchestrator models) build on false capabilities.
RISK-5: Unknown-kind brittleness — panicking or dropping on unrecognized session/update kinds or stop reasons breaks the lane on every adapter version bump.
minimum_controls: CTRL-1 (RISK-1): agent-client-protocol crate is the only wire implementation; acceptance criterion #1 enforces the dependency; review rejects any hand-rolled ACP frame codec.
CTRL-2 (RISK-2): the fixture agent is built on the crate's agent side and communicates over real child stdio; at least one proof target runs the full protocol round-trip.

CTRL-3 (RISK-3): fail-closed ledger semantics copied from official_cli_bridge.rs (LedgerPreflight/LedgerRegistration); dedicated test proves preflight failure prevents spawn and mid-turn death reaps the child.
CTRL-4 (RISK-4): steer_mid_turn=false is hardcoded for the ACP adapter (not configuration); resume defaults false and flips only on the negotiated loadSession capability; both proven by tests.
CTRL-5 (RISK-5): UnknownUpdate and TurnEndedUnknown typed fallbacks with raw payload retention; parameterized tests cover the unknown paths explicitly.

research_provenance.source: agentclientprotocol.com (JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio; reuses MCP JSON types; initialize -> session/new | session/load -> session/prompt -> session/update stream -> stop reason; NO mid-turn steer; official Rust crates agent-client-protocol + agent-client-protocol-schema on crates.io) + WP-017 stub research basis (.GOV/task_packets/stubs/WP-KERNEL-017-...contract.json draft_scope.research_basis, 2026-07-21 web passes) + inspected product code: official_cli_bridge.rs (CliInvocation/GuardedCliChild/ledger fail-closed patterns), mcp/jsonrpc.rs + mcp/transport (in-repo JSON-RPC reference).
corrections: SteerMidTurn=false is a protocol fact for ACP (sequential turns, cancel-then-reprompt only), not an implementation choice; native stream-json/app-server adapters (other MT families) carry first-class mid-turn steering.
Resume is capability-gated (loadSession), not universal; claude-agent-acp had a Windows path-encoding resume blocker — regression coverage assigned to MT-066.
claude-agent-acp does not emit usage/cost events (July 2026): usage_update handling is still built and fixture-proven here; the live gap is ledgered in MT-066.
